title: OpenAI Astra updates: Playco game prototyping and Legora financial review
summary: Two leaked OpenAI pages showcase Astra's capabilities: Playco used Astra as a basic grey-box prototype to generate styled game variants in Unity and Godot with 50% fewer manual fixes. Legora had Astra review 41 financial documents, finding 4 pre-inserted errors including a £500k discrepancy in minutes. Astra is positioned as a multi-step agent for long-document tasks without constant human oversight.
